title: A Network's Network tab calls its member Spaces chapters

source.ref: Production walk of The Group as a first member (2026-10-19): the Network tab headed its six chapters Member Spaces.

detail: The Network tab's section heading, page description and empty state follow the parent's plan: Chapters on a Network (NAMING: a Network is one owner running chapters, and its Chapters door already uses the word), Member Spaces on a Collective. The tab label stays Network, which the public nav test pins. No data or routing changes.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/network/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/isNetworkPlan\(parent.plan\) \? \{ plural: 'Chapters'/.test(s))bad.push('a Network no longer says Chapters');if(!/plural: 'Member Spaces'/.test(s))bad.push('a Collective no longer says Member Spaces');if(/title=\"Member Spaces\"/.test(s))bad.push('the heading is hard-typed');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-954: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
